definitions: A circular ornamental headdress worn by a monarch as a symbol of authority, usually made of gold and jewels.
The monarch as head of state.
The top or highest part of something.
The part of a tooth that is visible above the gum.
A coin, especially a British coin worth five shillings.
examples: The Queen wore a magnificent crown.
The Crown has the power to dissolve Parliament.
The crown of the tree was covered in snow.
He needed a crown on his molar.
He found an old crown in his grandfather's collection.
